blackout.note: French law (Act No. 77-808 of 19 July 1977) forbids publishing election poll results the day before and the day of each round. Periods are local wall-clock time in the given timezone, end exclusive. Read by js/pages-common.js (client) and scripts/build_data.py (server); keep both in step. Extra cron entries at these boundaries live in .github/workflows/update-data.yml.
